raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure presents two stacked bar charts and a line graph, all illustrating the share of public spending as a percentage of GDP from 1991 to 2023, categorized by different levels of government and institutions. The horizontal axis represents the years, ranging from 1991 to 2023, with consistent intervals. The vertical axis indicates the percentage of GDP, scaled from -0.5 to 3.5, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The left chart displays stacked bars, where each bar is composed of three segments: blue for the federal government (Bund), purple for the states (Länder), and green for municipalities (Gemeinden), showing their respective contributions to total public spending. The right chart features a line graph representing the total share of public spending by regional authorities (Gebietskörperschaften insgesamt), marked by a black line, overlaid on a background of stacked bars in the same color scheme as the left chart. A vertical dashed line labeled "Bahnreform" indicates a significant event around the year 2000, with an arrow pointing to the corresponding year. The data series are consistently represented across both charts, with the legend at the bottom clarifying the color coding for each category. The bars and line are arranged chronologically, with no apparent sorting by value, and no visual emphasis or highlighting is applied to specific data points.
